title: Service Call Fees and Repair Guarantee Periods — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
The service call fee charged on a Real Estate Service Contracts service request depends on the plan and on whether the request falls in the seller phase (listing coverage) or the buyer phase (after closing). The repair guarantee period is set per plan alongside it.

## Fee and guarantee schedule

| Plan | Buyer-phase service call fee per request | Seller-phase service call fee per request | Repair guarantee period (calendar days after a completed repair) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | $100.00 | $100.00 | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | $85.00 | $85.00 | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | $75.00 | $75.00 | 30 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | $75.00 | $75.00 | 60 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | $75.00 | $75.00 | 60 |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | $75.00 | $0.00 | 60 |

## What each figure is

- **Buyer-phase service call fee**: the fee per service request during buyer coverage.
- **Seller-phase service call fee**: the fee per service request during seller listing coverage. The Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan shows $0.00 because it carries no seller listing coverage.
- **Repair guarantee period**: the calendar days after a completed repair during which a recall for the same failure carries no fee.

## Points of reading

- On the five Bridgewell Closing plans the seller-phase fee equals the buyer-phase fee of the same plan.
- The repair guarantee period is 60 days on the Bridgewell Closing Premier, Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year and Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plans and 30 days on the other three plans.
